data.long_meaning: One who bears witness to the truth, a martyr. The name Istishhad carries the meaning “Testimony, Martyrdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Istishhad usually hope their child will grow to embody testimony, martyrdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are willing to give their lives for their beliefs and values.
data.etymology: Istishhad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Testimony, Martyrdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Istishhad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: استشهاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: استشهاد هو طلب الشهادة أو التشهير بالحق، وهو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'اشهد' الذي يعني 'أن يشهد' أو 'أن يطلب الشهادة'. في السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يعني هذا الاسم السعي للحصول على شهادة أو تأكيد للحق أو الحقيقة. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الفعل في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا' (الإسراء: 36)، حيث يشير إلى أهمية الشهادة والتحقق من الصحة.

in_urdu.name: استشهاد
in_urdu.meaning: گواہی طلب کرنا یا حق کا اظہار
in_urdu.long_meaning: استشهاد کا مطلب ہے گواہی طلب کرنا یا حق کا اظہار کرنا۔ یہ نام 'اشهد' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'گواہی دینا' یا 'گواہی طلب کرنا'۔ اسلامی 맥ام میں، یہ نام حق یا حقیقت کی گواہی حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کے معنی میں ہو سکتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر اردوگو بولنے والے ممالک میں۔

in_hindi.name: इस्तिशहाद
in_hindi.meaning: गवाही माँगना या सच का प्रकटीकरण
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्तिशहाद का अर्थ है गवाही माँगना या सच का प्रकटीकरण। यह नाम 'इशहाद' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'गवाही देना' या 'गवाही माँगना'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम सच्चाई या तथ्य की गवाही प्राप्त करने के प्रयास को दर्शाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है, जहाँ यह अरबी मूल के नामों की परंपरा को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: استشهاد
in_pashto.meaning: د ګواهۍ غوښتنه یا د حق څرګندول
in_pashto.long_meaning: استشهاد د ګواهۍ غوښتنه یا د حق څرګندول دي. دا نوم د 'اشهد' فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'ګواهي ورکول' یا 'ګواهۍ غوښتنه' دي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د حق يا حقيقیت ګواهۍ ترلاسه کولو هڅې معنی لري. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتو ژبې د مسلمانانو لخوا کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Istishhad
in_english.meaning: Seeking testimony or declaration of truth
in_english.long_meaning: Istishhad is derived from the Arabic root 'sh-h-d', which means 'to witness' or 'to testify'. In an Islamic context, Istishhad refers to the act of seeking testimony or affirmation of truth. This name reflects the importance of bearing witness to the truth and is associated with the concept of Shahada, the declaration of faith in Islam. The term and its variants appear in the Quran, emphasizing the role of testimony in establishing justice and truth. The name Istishhad carries spiritual significance, indicating a commitment to seeking and upholding truth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Istishhad" holds significant cultural importance within the Islamic faith, as it is given to those who have died for their beliefs or in the cause of Islam. This designation signifies the ultimate sacrifice and bravery, and is a source of pride for the Muslim community. The concept of martyrdom is deeply rooted in Islamic history, with numerous examples of individuals who have given their lives for the faith, including the Prophet Muhammad's companions and various other notable figures.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Istishhad" holds great significance as it symbolizes the ultimate selfless act of giving one's life for the sake of Allah. The belief is that those who die as martyrs are granted the highest level of paradise in the afterlife, where they will be reunited with Allah and receive eternal peace and happiness. This spiritual reward is believed to outweigh any worldly possessions or achievements, making the name "Istishhad" a reminder of the importance of faith, sacrifice, and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Istishhad in Arabic means "martyrdom". It symbolizes the selfless sacrifice of one's life for the sake of Allah and the Muslim community. In the spiritual realm, it represents the highest form of devotion and love for the divine, leading to eternal reward in the hereafter.

historical_references.reference: Al-Istishhadi bi-Tarikh al-Islam: Al-Imam Al-Askari wa-Asrafa Ahwalihi (The Martyr Who Recorded History: The Imam al-Askari and His Extraordinary Affairs)
historical_references.context: Refers to the martyrdom of the 11th Shia Imam, Al-Hasan al-Askari, in 868 CE. The term 'Istishhad' refers to the martyrdom of a religious leader or scholar.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Our'an, Surah Al-Anfal, Verse 75 The name Istishhad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: This verse in the Quran mentions the companions of the Prophet Muhammad who were martyred at the Battle of Uhud in 625 CE. They are referred to as the 'shuhada' or martyrs, and the term 'Istishhad' comes from this Arabic root meaning 'to give a martyr a shahada or testification'.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Istishhad remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
